summary: All 5 plan phases closed and committed in one dispatch. Phase 1 (item C): re-scanned and confirmed 57 below-floor max_time dicts (not the research report's 22) across bimodal/exclusion/imposition, measured the previously-unmeasured max_time:5 cohort (35 examples, 0.012s-1.549s isolated) before raising it alongside the already-measured 22-item 2/3 cohort, raised all 57 to the unchanged 10s floor, extended _COVERED to the three files; full gate green (2323/2323, 0 failed). Phase 2 (item A input): ran the bounded four-draw -n6-vs-n4 falsification screen under taskset -c0,1,2,3; all four pairwise diffs (cross-n x2, within-n x2) were empty -- CLEAN, with the required 'falsifies, does not prove CI-safe' limitation recorded per TESTING_GUIDE 8.13's already-established local-vs-CI divergence. Phase 3 (item A decision): applied the plan's clean-branch rule verbatim -- changed -n 6 to -n 4 in tests.yml and flake.nix together, demonstrated test_workflow_parity.py's test_worker_count_matches RED on a one-sided edit first, retained the BM_CM_1/never-auto rationale verbatim, appended the falsification-screen evidence and a named revert trigger, left timeout-minutes: 20 unchanged with a written wall-clock comparison. Phase 4 (item D): added .github/scripts/worker_rss_sample.py, a /proc-only (no new CI dependency) peak-RSS-per-xdist-worker sampler with 20 hermetic unit tests and a live smoke test against a real pytest -n 2 process; wired into tests.yml's existing step, 3.12-gated and strictly non-gating; root cause left explicitly open in both the module docstring and TESTING_GUIDE.md. Phase 5: rewrote TESTING_GUIDE.md 8.13 (widened-coverage + -n-change paragraphs) and extended 8.11 with a full D subsection; ran the full gate set (code/tests/ci/ 58/58, code/tests/ 439 passed/1 skipped/0 failed, full -n4 gating selection two-pass split 2343 passed/1 skipped + 9 passed, all green, no narrowing needed); verified the task-wide hard-constraint gate (GATING_RECHECK_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS=40000, MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS=100, _MIN_MAX_TIME=10 all unchanged; oracle differential test file untouched; every removed max_time value was 2/3/5, never >=10; BM_CM_1=60/BM_CM_4=120 byte-identical). Item B was already closed and remained untouched throughout. Five phase commits, tests green before each.
decisions_made: Phase 1 re-ran the below-floor AST scan rather than trusting the research report's '22' figure, confirmed exactly 57 (bimodal 21, exclusion 26, imposition 10) at the RED step, and measured the 35-item max_time:5 cohort in isolation before raising it -- direct run_test() calls were used for three bimodal names not collected by any pytest suite (TN_CM_1, MF_MODAL_FUTURE_TH via KNOWN_TIMEOUT_EXAMPLES; BM_TH_5 never added to unit_tests), since the AST guard reads the source file directly regardless of test collection.

Phase 2's screen was CLEAN (all four pairwise diffs empty across 2323 executed node ids), so Phase 3 took the clean branch per the plan's decision rule: -n 6 -> -n 4 in both tests.yml and flake.nix, together, with the parity guard demonstrated RED on a one-sided edit first.

timeout-minutes: 20 was left unchanged -- Phase 2's four draws showed no systematic -n 4 slowdown (~5% average difference, well inside the ~70s draw-to-draw spread; the single fastest draw overall was an -n 4 draw), so there was no basis to raise it.

Phase 4's sampler is wired inline within the existing 'Run general test suite' step rather than as a literal separate GH Actions step, and the parallel-pass pytest invocation is now backgrounded unconditionally (not per-version-branch) -- a first, per-branch-duplicated attempt broke test_workflow_parity.py's single-parallel-pass assertions, exactly the class of regression the plan's own Phase 4 Verification section warns is a real finding, not a test to adjust.

Item B was re-confirmed closed and untouched by Phase 5's task-wide hard-constraint git diff gate: GATING_RECHECK_SOLVE_TIMEOUT_MS, MIN_CONCLUSIVE_GATING_FORMULAS unchanged, oracle differential test file has zero diff since before this task.
next_action_hint: Task is ready to close: all 5 phases COMPLETED, all verification green, all hard constraints confirmed intact. A future task should read accumulated Python 3.12 CI telemetry (worker_rss_sample.py output, once several runs have accumulated) to decide item D's memory hypothesis on data, and watch the next several CI runs for the -n 4 revert trigger named in tests.yml's comment (a countermodel-expected example losing its countermodel, or a new contention-shaped failure).
